notes: Refined existing stories to strengthen core logic and UI synchronization; no new stories created per dedup constraint.

change_log.value: Implement core frontend logic to transform provider data into map markers, including clustering support (e.g., marker clustering library), viewport bounds filtering, and handling missing or invalid coordinates.
change_log.note: Strengthen core logic with clustering and bounds handling

change_log.value: Develop a reusable map component that renders provider markers, supports zoom/pan interactions, displays provider summary on marker click, and synchronizes with list/search results (selection + hover states).

stories.title: Define Map Provider Data Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the frontend data contract for rendering providers on a map, including latitude, longitude, provider name, specialty, and identifier. Ensure compatibility with existing provider search outputs.

stories.title: Implement Map Marker Rendering Logic
stories.description: Implement core frontend logic to transform provider data into map markers, including clustering support (e.g., marker clustering library), viewport bounds filtering, and handling missing or invalid coordinates.

stories.title: Build Interactive Map UI Component
stories.description: Develop a reusable map component that renders provider markers, supports zoom/pan interactions, displays provider summary on marker click, and synchronizes with list/search results (selection + hover states).

stories.title: Map Rendering Test Suite
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating marker rendering, clustering behavior, and UI interactions such as click and zoom.

stories.title: Integrate Map with Provider Search Results
stories.description: Connect the map component to provider search outputs so that search results dynamically populate map markers and update on new queries.
